maya: quick sanity check — if a client sends `model_hints: [\"gptx-3\", \"redwood-medium\"]`, `region: \"eu-west\"`, and `route_tier: \"reserved\"`, which model do we pick? saw a case where fallback served a quantized variant last week :eyes:
alex: short answer: order is pinned_model -> exact model_id -> hinted models (filtered by compatibility + region/tier) -> region fallback -> global fallback. If reserved pool has no compatible variant, we try hosted fallback matching region then global.
jonathan: compatibility filter: an hinted model must have a compatible "serving_shape" with the request (seq len, kv cache support, quantization tolerance). we also check "variant_family" (eg gptx-3 vs gptx-3-q8 are same family but not always interchangeable for reserved tier).
linh: edge case: if hint includes both float32 and q8 variants, reserved pool prefers non-quant if the tier requested is "reserved" and quant profiles are only allowed on "burst". this bit tripped us in #2345.
olivia: note — we changed the fallback order in the api contract last month to prefer region-local hosted variants for data locality. possible this wasn't released to dedicated yet. i filed a docs PR to make the decision table explicit: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/2784 :book:
maya: thanks. can someone confirm expected API response shape when fallback happens? iirc we populate `served_model` + `served_variant` and `fallback_reason` fields. want to make sure SDKs don't break.
alex: yes, contract is `served_model` (string), `served_variant` (string optional), `fallback_reason` (enum: NONE | COMPAT_MISMATCH | CAPACITY | REGION_UNAVAILABLE). add `route_meta` for chosen pool id.
jonathan: also watch for `served_model` changing between minor releases — it's stable only for pinned_model or explicit model_id. hints can map to multiple families; callers should treat `served_model` as opaque.
linh: small nit: when family maps to a quantized runtime we include `compatibility_notes: [\"quantized\"]` in metadata so downstream can decide to re-run evals.
maya: perfect. i'm updating the integration tests. pinging @alex and @jonathan for a quick CR on the contract test tweak (small change in assertions).
alex: on it, will review in next 30m :thumbsup:
olivia: fyi i'll also add a note in the console docs per env so product doesn't get surprised.
